name: Council of Nicaea
coreDoctrines: the Son is begotten, not made
the Son is of one essence with the Father
guardsAgainst: treating Christ as a created being
subordinating the Son beneath the Father in essence
using biblical language to deny Christ's divinity
discernmentQuestions: Does this confess Christ as truly God?
Does it preserve worship of Father, Son, and Spirit?
Does it make Christ less than the saving Lord revealed in Scripture?
